title: Quarterly convergence playbook: hosted API model discovery, gating & enablement
creator: Amina Patel
description: Background: As we scale hosted API usage and onboard new open models, product teams need a single, predictable cadence for adding, gating, and deprecating models in the Hosted API catalog. Past quarters surfaced mismatches between model discovery (research), operational readiness (runtime/ops), and product enablement (docs/SDKs). This ticket collects the quarterly playbook, milestones, owners, and measurable OKRs to align cross-functional work.
scope: In-scope: model discovery flow (onboarding checklist), model gating criteria (perf, cost, regressions), canary rollout for hosted variants, documentation & quickstarts, cost/latency SLAs and rollback triggers. Out-of-scope: full training lifecycle, private deployment automation, customer-specific model contracts.
goals: 1) Establish a repeatable quarter-long cadence for model additions (discovery -> vetting -> canary -> GA). 2) Ship a gating checklist that prevents >5% regression in quality or >15% cost increase vs baseline. 3) Provide internal playbook and one-click enablement checklist for customer-facing product teams.
success_metrics:
- Time from discovery to GA <= 6 weeks (median)
- Fewer than 2 regressions causing SLA breaches in the quarter
- 95% of new model additions include docs + SDK sample + rollout plan
- Internal satisfaction (stakeholder survey) >= 4/5
acceptance_criteria:
- Playbook document published and reviewed by Eng/Design/SRE/Research (link below)
- A canonical onboarding checklist YAML added to the model-catalog repo
- Canary automation templates merged (GitHub PR linked in updates)
- Two pilot model additions executed end-to-end during cycle with postmortems
- OKR entry created and owners assigned

risks_and_mitigations: - Risk: Canary routing may add latency spikes if misconfigured. Mitigation: limit canary percentage and add automated rollback based on P99 latency signal.\n- Risk: Model quality regressions post-quantization. Mitigation: require quality evals + baseline A/B test before GA.\n- Risk: Cross-team sync delays. Mitigation: bi-weekly cadence with explicit RSVP and shared decision log.
